{{Term/Store|Extra Hearts||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}}</ref>

==Overview==
Extra Hearts is an [[Added Effect]] in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}} that fully restores [[Link]]'s health and provides him with extra yellow [[Heart]]s that absorb damage. These Hearts cannot be restored once used, but they can be replaced by reapplying the Effect.  

==={{BotW|-}}===
In {{BotW|-}}, the total amount of Hearts in Link's [[Life Gauge]] cannot exceed 30. The following [[Material]]s grant Extra Hearts when cooked in [[Meal]]s or [[Elixir]]s:

* [[Hearty Durian]]
* [[Big Hearty Truffle]]
* [[Hearty Truffle]]
* [[Big Hearty Radish]]
* [[Hearty Radish]]
* [[Hearty Salmon]]
* [[Hearty Bass]]
* [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]
* [[Hearty Lizard]]

==={{TotK|-}}===
In {{TotK|-}}, the total amount of Hearts in Link's Life Gauge cannot exceed 40. This figure includes Hearts that have been affected by [[Gloom]]. If Link receives Gloom damage from any source, any extra Hearts he has will all be consumed at once, after which his [[Heart Container]]s will be damaged as normal. Furthermore, if Link has Gloom-stricken Hearts when he is granted Extra Hearts, any [[Gloom Recovery]] will convert them into regular Hearts. The following [[Material]]s impart Extra Hearts in {{TotK|-}}:

* [[Big Hearty Truffle]]
* [[Hearty Truffle]]
* [[Big Hearty Radish]]
* [[Hearty Radish]]
* [[Hearty Salmon]]
* [[Hearty Bass]]
* [[Hearty Lizard]]
